title: 30 Muscle-ups for Time
creator: CrossFit
description: Thirty ring muscle-ups as fast as you can, a crossfit.com staple since 2007. Everything hinges on the transition, so break into small sets from the start rather than failing big ones. If you cannot do muscle-ups, the prescribed substitute is 120 pull-ups and 120 dips.
